newsitem.title: USA: APICS business outlook index rose to 53.0 in July.
newsitem.headline: APICS business outlook index rose to 53.0 in July.

text.p: The Educational Society for Resource Management's APICS business outlook index rose to 53.0 in July from 52.4 in June.
The APICS index surveys current and future conditions in American production and inventory control.
The current component index rose to 52.4 in July versus 51.9 the previous month. The future component index rose to 53.7 from 52.9.
A reading of 50 indicates neutral sentiment, APICS said.
Manufacturing employment rose for the fourth month in a row, to 59.8 from 54.1, according to the report.
"This gain is attributed in part to fewer summer plant closings than usual, although even without that factor, employment gains appear robust," it said.
Both shipments and new orders strengthened in July, rising to 57.3 and 56.4, respectively.
Production plans fell to 48.5 in July, which suggests somewhat less growth in production over the next three months, the report said.
The APICS index is compiled monthly from a survey of manufacturing firms and is calculated by averaging respondents' ratings of current and future conditions.
